notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
notes.notes: [h1]Hey There![/h1][p][/p][p]As we continue development on ONEiRA, we wanted to answer some of the most common questions we’ve seen from the community. Whether you just discovered the game or have been following us for a while, thank you! Your curiosity and support mean the world to us. Now... let’s dive in:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]❓ What is ONEiRA?[/b][/p][p]ONEiRA is a narrative-driven puzzle-platformer where your choices matter. Explore a world where dreams are sold as entertainment and your job is to ensure each is market-ready.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🗓️ [b]When will the game release?[/b][/p][p]We’re aiming to release ONEiRA in [b]2026.[/b] As with any indie game, this could shift slightly, but we’re committed to transparency every step of the way.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎮 [b]What platforms will ONEiRA be on?[/b][/p][p]Our initial release is planned for [b]PC via Steam[/b]. We’re also exploring other platforms (like consoles), but nothing is confirmed yet. Will update you as soon as we know more![/p][hr][/hr][p]🧠 [b]What kind of gameplay can I expect?[/b][/p][p]ONEiRA is hard to compare but think a mix of [b]Portal[/b], [b]The Talos Principle[/b], and a little bit of [b]Psychonauts[/b]. You'll traverse obstacles, solve puzzles, make dialogue choices that affect the story.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🧩 [b]Is this a linear game?[/b][/p][p]The story is [b]narrative-driven[/b] but your [b]choices matter[/b]. There are multiple outcomes based on how you explore, interact, and resolve each dream scenario. It’s not open-world, but it’s far from “on rails.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🕖 [b]How long will the game be?[/b][/p][p]We're estimating a playtime of around [b]6–8 hours[/b], depending on how deeply you explore and how quickly you solve puzzles. Completionists may take longer.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔁 [b]Is there replayability?[/b][/p][p]Absolutely. Your decisions lead to different outcomes, and some content can only be experienced on certain paths. We're also including some [b]hidden lore[/b] and [b]collectibles[/b] for players who dig deeper.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ [b]Who’s making this?[/b][/p][p]A small, passionate indie team over at [url="https://dreammatterlabs.com/"][b]Dream Matter Labs[/b][/url]! We're artists, developers, writers, and dreamers—committed to telling a story that stays with you long after you’ve finished it.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Add to Wishlist:[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521080/ONEiRA/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Why We're Making ONEiRA
notes.notes: [h1]Hello World![/h1][p][/p][p]For the past 1.5 years, we’ve been working tirelessly on ONEiRA; a narrative-driven puzzle-platformer where your choices matter. It’s a very special project to us, so we wanted to take a moment to introduce ourselves and share with you why![/p][p][/p][h2]Who We Are[/h2][p][/p][p]For starters, we’re [url="https://dreammatterlabs.com/" buttoncolor="#b1f8f2"][b]Dream Matter Labs[/b][/url], a brand-new indie studio founded by a team of juniors![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595939/27f8736e599bc97f7b828d31d2974fd8af401330.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our entire team has firsthand experienced how impossible it is to break into the game industry nowadays. What was once a welcoming place filled with experimentation and unconventionality, has now shut its doors and become a place deprived of these very same qualities.[/p][p][/p][p]In 2024 alone, [url="https://www.statista.com/statistics/1458214/worldwide-gaming-industry-layoffs/" buttoncolor="#b1f8f2"][b]14.600 people lost their jobs in the game industry[/b][/url] as companies prioritized their short-term metrics and downsized their teams. As a result, the job market is now bursting at the seams with more and more people desperate for an opportunity.[/p][p][/p][p]Especially for juniors, breaking into the game industry has become an impossible feat as entry-level jobs have seemingly become a figment of the past. Because of that, we have concluded that the beaten path for us was one with a dead end, and that we needed to forge our own...[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, our dear Dream Matter Labs was born! Here, while we show the industry exactly what we can do, we're hard at work to make our dreams become our reality—and what better way to do that than by making an entire game about dreams![/p][p][/p][h2]The Birth of ONEiRA[/h2][p][/p][p]Granted, ONEiRA wasn't created out of very deliberate, introspective decisions, but rather by chance during the [url="https://itch.io/jam/lsdjam-2023" buttoncolor="#b1f8f2"][b]LSDJam 2023[/b][/url]. This event was like a love letter to [b]LSD Dream Emulator[/b] and the very place where our team crossed paths and conceptualized ONEiRA.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595939/4ef54e2eff7da8a0d5f4517ad0fc4405e5bc3884.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As time went on, one thing led to another, and both the team and ONEiRA grew substantially. Following this, we now had the opportunity to really give this game the time and energy it deserved, and have it be our entry ticket into the game industry. Naturally... we took it![/p][p][/p][p]Because of all this, we're writing this today. In a way, ONEiRA has since become an extension of ourselves and we try to put as much of ourselves into it as we can. Now, the most exciting part is that we are able to share it with you and have the chance to shape it alongside you.[/p][p][/p][p]After all, we want to make games for our players and place high importance on your perspectives and experiences. SO, If you;d like to follow and influence development up-close, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/XAYvJhkkqE" buttoncolor="#b1f8f2"][b]Discord[/b][/url]! We'd love to chat with you and have you playtest ONEiRA as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Regardless, thank you all so much for your support! More soon... [/p][p][/p][h2]Add to Wishlist:[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521080/ONEiRA/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
